IC2: Inability to complete 400 m walk within 15 minutes without sitting [OR] or interpersonal assistance, as an indicator of disablement and likely inability to fully engage in the exercise intervention
IC3: Primary indication for ACE inhibitor use, i.e. Congestive Heart Failure [OR], CAD [OR], diabetes
IC5: Resistant hypertension, defined as BP > 140/90, despite the use of three or more anti-hypertensive drugs
IC6: Office or average home SBP [OR] > 180 mm Hg or DBP > 110 mm Hg (Average home BP in any seven day period during trial)
IC8: Serum creatinine >2.5 mg/dL in men [OR], or >2.0 mg/dL in women
IC11: Abnormal liver enzymes (Aspartate transaminase (AST) [OR], Alanine transaminase (ALT) [OR], or alkaline phosphatase > 2.5 times the upper limit of normal)
IC12: Severe cardiac disease [OR], including New York Heart Association Class III or IV congestive heart failure [OR], clinically significant aortic stenosis [OR], history of cardiac arrest [OR], use of a cardiac defibrillator [OR], or uncontrolled angina
IC13: Acute myocardial infarction identified by ECG
IC14: Lives in a nursing home (persons living in assisted or independent housing will not be excluded)
IC15: Significant cognitive impairment [OR], defined as a known diagnosis of dementia [OR] or a Mini-Mental State Examination exam score < 24
IC16: Unable to communicate because of severe hearing loss [OR] or speech disorder
IC17: Severe visual impairment, which would preclude completion of the assessments and/or intervention
IC18: Other significant co-morbid disease that would prevent participation in exercise
IC19: Planning to move out of the area during the study time frame
IC20: Simultaneous participation in another intervention trial
